top_signals.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 7
top_signals.summary: Oil extended gains after a report that Iran attacked “hostile targets” in the Strait of Hormuz, with Tehran seeking to bar US ships from the critical waterway in a deal with Oman.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: South Africa Already Upgraded by Bond Market as Rating Firms Lag
top_signals.summary: South African authorities are focused on hitting budget targets rather than pleasing credit-rating firms, according to the government’s top finance official — and the reward is a bond market that’s already pricing the country’s debt as investment grade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
